description: This file implements the Groq speech-to-text (STT) service using Whisper models. It defines the GroqSTTService class which inherits from a base whisper STT service class, providing specific configuration for the Groq API and handling transcriptions asynchronously.

classes.name: GroqSTTService
classes.description: A speech-to-text service class that uses Groq's Whisper API for transcription, allowing configuration of model, API key, language, prompt, and other parameters.
